# `vox-db-types`

**Crate:** `vox-db-types` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Pure-data L0 leaf for vox-db: row types, IDs, schema descriptors.

## Crate Overview

# vox-db-types — Pure data types for [`vox-db`](../vox_db/index.html)

Lightweight crate holding parameter and row structs used by the `vox-db` facade.
Consumers that only need types (not connection-bearing operations) can depend on
this crate to avoid pulling in `turso` and other heavy operational deps.

`vox-db` re-exports everything here for back-compat: `vox_db::SaveSnippetParams`
resolves the same as `vox_db_types::SaveSnippetParams`.


## Public API Surface

### Modules

| Module | Description |
|---|---|
| `circuit` | Circuit-breaker state enum (`CircuitState`) for `vox_db::circuit_breaker`. |
| `workspace_journey` | Workspace-journey store mode enum (`WorkspaceJourneyStoreMode`). |
| `exec_time` | Execution time telemetry types (`ExecOutcome`, `ExecTimeRecord`, `ToolLatencyProfile`). |
| `eval_params` | Parameters for [`crate::EvalRunParams`] (RLHF / dogfood eval-run recording). |
| `store_types` | Request parameters, row shapes, and MENS observation/training types (formerly `vox_db::store::types::*`). |
| `research` | SCIENTIA / research-session row DTOs. |
| `ids` | Typed string-ID newtypes for DB row fields (UUIDs, hashes, human-readable IDs). |
| `retrieval` | Hybrid retrieval planning types and rank-fusion helpers (vector + keyword search). Shared contracts used by MCP, the orchestrator, and VoxDb-backed retrieval surfaces. |
